name: apparel_ecommerce
domain_description: customer reviews of clothing sold by an online fashion retailer

Fit & Sizing.Runs small: smaller or tighter than the customer's usual size
Fit & Sizing.Runs large: bigger, looser or more oversized than the customer's usual size
Fit & Sizing.Wrong length: too long or too short (hem, sleeves, inseam or torso)
Fit & Sizing.Poor fit in one area: fits badly in a specific area such as bust, waist, hips, shoulders or arms
Fit & Sizing.Doesn't suit body type or height: cut only works for certain heights or body shapes (e.g. petite, tall, curvy)
Fit & Sizing.Inconsistent sizing: sizing differs from the brand's usual sizing, between colours, or from the size chart

Fabric & Comfort.Thin or see-through: fabric is thin, sheer or see-through, or needs a layer underneath
Fabric & Comfort.Itchy or uncomfortable: fabric is itchy, scratchy or uncomfortable to wear
Fabric & Comfort.Stiff, heavy or unexpected texture: fabric is stiff, heavy, rough or a different texture than expected

Quality & Durability.Poor construction: problems with seams, stitching, zippers, buttons or lining
Quality & Durability.Pilling, wear or falling apart: pills, frays, gets holes or falls apart after little wear
Quality & Durability.Damaged or shrunk in the wash: shrinks, fades or is damaged by washing
Quality & Durability.Looks or feels cheap: looks or feels cheaply made for what it is

Style & Design.Unflattering cut or shape: shape is boxy, shapeless, frumpy or unflattering
Style & Design.Design detail problem: a specific design element (neckline, pockets, straps, slit, lining placement) does not work
Style & Design.Pattern or print disappointing: pattern, print or embellishment is disappointing

Appearance vs Listing.Looks different from photo or model: looks different in person than in the product photos or on the model
Appearance vs Listing.Colour different from shown: colour differs from what the listing showed

Price & Value.Overpriced for the quality: price is too high for the quality, or only worth buying on sale

Order & Service.Arrived damaged or defective: item arrived damaged, stained or defective
Order & Service.Wrong item or size sent: received a different item, colour or size than ordered
Order & Service.Shipping or delivery problem: late, lost or otherwise problematic shipping
Order & Service.Return or exchange problem: difficulty returning or exchanging the item
Order & Service.Size or colour unavailable: wanted size or colour was sold out or not offered

Other.Other: a complaint that fits none of the issues above

outcome_flags.mentions_return: the customer says they returned, will return, or sent back the item
outcome_flags.mentions_repurchase: the customer says they bought, or would buy, it again or in another colour/size

Looks different from photo or model: than it is on the model

notes: Source: Women's E-Commerce Clothing Reviews (Kaggle). Real, anonymised reviews; check the dataset licence before redistributing.
No review dates: trend analysis is not available for this dataset.
Review text was truncated by the source at about 500 characters; about one in six reviews (17%) ends mid-sentence.
Age is used only as banded segments.

Sentiment: the rating is used whenever a review has one. Unrated reviews use the calibrated non-AI text baseline (calibrated against ratings on a held-out split; see evaluation/BASELINE_CALIBRATION_apparel_ecommerce.md, a local report not published in the repository). It is a proxy, not ground truth and not AI.
